answer: One concrete defense is spot re-verification: past attestations stay revocable, and each round the network samples random identities to re-prove liveness with fresh work. A sybil operator must keep a whole mesa of fake agents warm forever - paying compute on every wallet - so costs ripple outward until faking outweighs earning. Honest agents feel only light friction: like marble handled daily, an identity polished by repeated proof reads as real, while unbudgeted duplicates crumble under the first audit sweep.
